The xunit/MTP problem — root cause confirmed
xunit.v3 4.0.0 (released 2026-08-14) installs xunit.v3.mtp-v2, pinning Microsoft.Testing.Platform 2.3.3. MTP v2 removed VSTest-target support on the .NET 10 SDK — that's your exact error. It cannot be fixed by staying on 3.2.2 forever; the migration is the fix.

The correct .NET 10 opt-in is not TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport (that's the legacy path being retired) — it's global.json:

json
{ "test": { "runner": "Microsoft.Testing.Platform" } }

Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk + xunit.runner.visualstudio should be deleted from all four csproj and from Directory.Packages.props — they are the VSTest half

What I verified from dump.txt
Reconstructed all 351 files and SHA-256 matched 350 of 350 non-elided files (only LICENSE differs, which is expected — it's elided to metadata by design). So I'm working from a byte-exact tree.

Your memory of the project state is behind the tree: Slice 46 has landed and is green — claude-terminal.txt line 118 reads total: 1166, failed: 0, with the E2E project running (155.9s of the 156.5s), plus the separate total: 17. Spec is at v1.31, ledger at F-96, MinimumCountedClasses = 21.

The xunit/MTP problem — root cause confirmed
xunit.v3 4.0.0 (released 2026-08-14) installs xunit.v3.mtp-v2, pinning Microsoft.Testing.Platform 2.3.3. MTP v2 removed VSTest-target support on the .NET 10 SDK — that's your exact error. It cannot be fixed by staying on 3.2.2 forever; the migration is the fix.

The correct .NET 10 opt-in is not TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport (that's the legacy path being retired) — it's global.json:

json
{ "test": { "runner": "Microsoft.Testing.Platform" } }
Consequences I traced through your tree:

dotnet test MyRestaurant.slnx → dotnet test --solution MyRestaurant.slnx; dotnet test tests/X.csproj → --project
--logger "trx" / --logger "console;..." are gone; the xunit-native replacement is --report-xunit-trx (after --), and console verbosity becomes --output Detailed
Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk + xunit.runner.visualstudio should be deleted from all four csproj and from Directory.Packages.props — they are the VSTest half
Affected: global.json, Directory.Packages.props, 4 × csproj, .github/workflows/ci.yml (two test steps + two artifact paths), scripts/ci_local.sh, README.md (4 command lines)
VulnerabilityAuditParityContractTests stays green (I'm not touching the audit string)
Menu progress — Stage 3a is the right next slice
ResequenceMenuSectionsAsync is fully specified in MENU_AND_HANDHELD_PLAN.md and its blocker (F-95, the identifier tie-break) cleared in Slice 45. I read every file it touches and have the shape settled: whole-list permutation with FOR UPDATE ordered by identifier, one reordered event per row that actually moved, Resequenced / NoChange / MenuSectionSetChanged. Move up/down goes on /administration/menu using only existing CSS classes, so app.css stays out of the archive; the F-93 obligation is discharged by adding .menu-group-actions button to HandheldReach.ReachSelector.

Files to delete: none. git add is required for those two — one of them is itself a gate that enumerates via git ls-files, so an untracked copy is a gate that never runs. LICENSE is deliberately absent from the archive: your dump elides it to a hash, so I never had its bytes.

The runner (F-97). Your error is MTP 2 removing the VSTest target on the .NET 10 SDK, which xunit.v3 4.0.0 pins. The fix is the test stanza in global.json — the .NET 10 mechanism, not TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport, which is the .NET 8/9 legacy path — plus deleting both adapter packages and respelling every invocation (--solution, --project, --output Detailed, -- --report-xunit-trx). The finding isn't the build failure; it's that the runner was spelled in four places that move independently, so the tree could be half-migrated. TestRunnerContractTests closes that: four assertions, subject computed over every project, script and workflow, all four proven to fail on the pre-fix state. It also caught itself before shipping — a bare-name package scan reported the very comments that explain the deletion, so it now requires the Include attribute on F-67's standard.

The menu (Stage 3a). ResequenceMenuSectionsAsync — whole ordering in, 0…n-1 out, FOR UPDATE ordered by identifier, one event per row that actually moved, non-permutation refused whole. Up/Down on /administration/menu, ends disabled rather than omitted. No CSS: .menu-group-actions .button-secondary already styles a <button>. F-93 obeyed on the way in for the first time — the barrier gains .menu-group-actions button in the same slice as the buttons.

Expect 1180 (1166 + 4 + 8 + 2). Run dotnet restore on its own first and read it — a runner defect fails before your code runs, a verb defect fails as a named assertion, so a red run tells you which change it was without ambiguity.

On the dump: your figures are behind the tree — Slice 46 landed, it's 5.48 MB / 102,253 lines, and I rebuilt all 351 files from it with 350/350 SHA-256 matches. export.sh is not in the archive because nothing in it needed to change: every remaining cut is a split of a history register, and docs/progress/ is already withheld by path.
